title: GTA 6 Official Release Window & Timeline Master Matrix
leadParagraph: Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled for launch on November 19, 2026 (Fall 2026) on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. This launch date establishes the next major entry in the franchise following more than a decade of development.

title: Take-Two Interactive Earnings Call Breakdown: GTA VI Guidance Analysis

title: GTA 6 Platforms Analysis: PS5, Xbox Series X/S & PC Delay Roadmap
leadParagraph: Grand Theft Auto VI will launch exclusively on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S at release, following Rockstar Games' historical staggered platform deployment strategy. A personal computer edition is projected to follow subsequent to the initial console window.
tokenChunk: Rockstar Games historically utilizes a multi-wave platform release strategy. Grand Theft Auto IV, Grand Theft Auto V, and Red Dead Redemption 2 each arrived on consoles first, with Windows PC editions releasing between 8 and 18 months afterward. Technical disclosures suggest this delay permits the team to engineer targeted low-level rendering optimizations for complex multi-vendor PC hardware architectures (DirectX 12 Ultimate, Vulkan) while maximizing initial console retail margins.

title: PS5 Pro Enhanced Features for GTA 6: Technical Expectation Engine

For GTA VI, this enables Rockstar's RAGE 9 engine to run hardware-accelerated ray-traced reflections and global illumination simultaneously while targeting 60 frames per second at reconstructed 4K display output, eliminating the traditional fidelity versus performance compromise.
